Class GameBuilder

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.GameBuilder
public class GameBuilder extends Object
Builds and configures a complete game (Builder pattern). Centralises all setup logic that would otherwise be scattered across Game, Board and App: deck shuffling, filtering by player count, initial food distribution, row and tile setup. Typical usage: 
  Game game = new GameBuilder()
      .withPlayers(List.of("Alice", "Bob"), List.of(RED, BLUE))
      .withCards(cardLoader.loadAll(path))
      .build();
After build() the Game is ready for game.start().
